allocation_method: Elapsed and prediction meters measured; active/wait split is a rough elapsed allocation. Prediction time overlaps active work, so is not additive. Explicit idle sleeps are included in the approximate3-minute wait allocation. No active-time floor;30-minute reassessment not reached.
estimate_explanation: Inherited harness and implementation passed immediately; clear negative screen eliminated packaging and official waiting. Initial100–130-minute estimate was conservative.
